output.objection: I did not ask for a manual sign off, I asked for the pipeline to move from risk check to acceptance automatically. If a human has to click approve, the deployment is not seamless.
output.correction: You are mixing up the governance review with the execution step. I want the tooling to trigger the acceptance criteria, not for me to sit in a meeting deciding if the model is ready.
